scripts.lint:all: for dir in crm7 R80.3 braden business-suite-unified conduit; do echo "\n=== Linting $dir ==="; (cd $dir && pnpm lint) || exit 1; done

scripts.build:all: for dir in crm7 R80.3 braden business-suite-unified conduit; do echo "\n=== Building $dir ==="; (cd $dir && pnpm build) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck:all: for dir in crm7 R80.3 braden business-suite-unified conduit; do echo "\n=== Typechecking $dir ==="; (cd $dir && pnpm tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; done
